email_body:
Dear Adam,

I have applied through the City's portal for the Development Engineer role advertised on SEEK, and wanted to reach you directly as the enquiries contact.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, designing road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, carrying out inspections and keeping site records. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa, so the fixed term to September 2027 suits me well.

Checking subdivision road and drainage drawings against Council standards is the work I most want to grow into. I have not yet worked in local government, and I would bring care and a willingness to learn your standards quickly.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am applying for the Development Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Helping deliver the road, drainage and ancillary works that come with subdivision developments, and checking that they meet Council standards, is the kind of work I want to build my civil career on.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and then as field engineer at Grand Travaux on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and prepared site reports and material records.

I have not yet worked in local government or under Victorian subdivision processes, and I would learn the City's standards quickly. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, which covers the fixed term to September 2027.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
